name: Snake Mountain macroform (volume: shell, serpent, shaft, floors, derived)
source: data/snake_mountain_surface.json + data/snake_mountain.json (masks.snake) via tools/derive_snake_macroform.py (numpy + scipy, reproduces this file bit for bit). DERIVED data, not the user's spreadsheets. PROVISIONAL parameters: docs/crystallizers/06-macroform/README.md.
note: Crystallizer 6, Macroform. `elevation` is the OUTER SURFACE (identical to snake_mountain_surface). `volume` holds, per column, the SOLID intervals [z0, z1, material] in ELEVATION units (z_tiles / vScale), bottom up; materials index `volume.materials` (air is never stored). The mountain is a shell with a hollow inside; the serpent is a traversable spiral ramp that crosses every floor; the central shaft is an addition (crater). Row-major, index = y*width + x, x grows east, y grows south. Nothing is exported to Unity.

markers.label: Snake head (high end of the serpent; marker only, no geometry)
